articles.title: Tennis Says: Same Game, Same Prize Money!
articles.summary: Starting next year, men and women will win equal prize money at all combined WTA 1,000 tennis events. That includes big tournaments in Rome, Canada, and Cincinnati. The WTA has been pushing for this since 1973.

articles.title: Marvel's New Show Has a Mystery Bad Guy—And Nobody Knows Who He Is!
articles.summary: A new Marvel show called "VisionQuest" is coming to Disney+ on October 14. It brings back Vision and introduces a mysterious mercenary named Paladin. Marvel says almost nothing is known about his background.

articles.title: Noah Kahan Wrote a Song for the New Hunger Games Movie!
articles.summary: Singer Noah Kahan released a new song called "Draw You Out" for the Hunger Games prequel "Sunrise on the Reaping." The song is about grief and hope. The album comes out November 13, and the movie hits theaters November 20.
